scientific_integrity: All universal conclusions rest on the displayed analytic proof. The bundled exact rational computations corroborate selected consequences and algebraic identities, but cannot certify uncountably many parameter choices. Existing coordinatewise beta monotonicity is identified explicitly as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Applies to beta shapes proportional to a fixed mean and the corresponding nt-1 binomial family; does not establish universal quantile-share feasibility, a general Erdős matching statement, or any ordering of entire beta distributions.
title: Proportional-beta mean-tail monotonicity and an exact binomial quantile threshold
